rows.en:
(It's discount day at Nyan-Nyan today!
I'm gonna eat to my heart's content!)
rows.notes: Male, frd_rnk_007; saabisu dee = special discount day.

rows.en:
Mmm~, Nyan-Nyan's maguro buns are so good~
I could eat a million of these.
Munch, munch...
Welcome~!

More customers?
This place is as busy as ever...

Excuse me, would you mind
if someone shared your table?
rows.notes: x2, Nyan-Nyan Clerk to the player (both genders); okyakusama left as neutral address.

rows.en: Huh? Yeah, sure...

Thank you very much.
Right this way, please...
rows.notes: x2, Nyan-Nyan Clerk, now leading the new customer (Ranka) over.

rows.en: Oh, okay... Sorry to bo-- Wait, huh?!
Whoa?! Ranka!
Ah! \p-kun!

What's up?
You're not on shift here today... are you?
rows.notes: Male; baito = her part-time job at Nyan-Nyan.

rows.en: Or wait, do you have the day off today?

Yeah.
I had work until a little while ago,
but I'm off for the rest of the day.
rows.notes: x2, Ranka; oshigoto = her singing work.

rows.en: I see, so you came to Nyan-Nyan to unwind.
Yeah! I got really hungry...
Then go ahead and order whatever you like.

Yeah, you always work so hard, Ranka,
so today it's my treat!

Wow~!
Thank you!!

Whoa, it's getting really crowded...
Those customers over there look like
they've been waiting forever...
Uuu~...
Ranka, what's wrong?

That's it!
I can't just sit here and watch!!
rows.notes: x2, Ranka; she jumps in to help the staff.

rows.en:
Hello there!
Welcome to Nyan-Nyan!!
rows.notes: x2, Ranka working; Nyan-Nyan hanten = 'Nyan-Nyan' as in c07058.

rows.en: Right this way, please!
Thank you so much~!
Huh... Isn't it getting even more packed...?
rows.notes: Male; implied: Ranka's presence draws more customers.

rows.en: Phew~, I worked up a good sweat!

You looked like you were having fun!
Did it remind you of how you started out?

Yeah, something like that!
I feel like I can give it my all again
starting tomorrow!
I see. Just don't overdo it, okay?

Okay!
You too, \p-kun! See ya!
Bye-bye!

(Yeah, I'd better work hard too,
so she doesn't leave me behind!)

(It's discount day at Nyan-Nyan today!
I'm gonna eat to my heart's content!)

Mmm~, Nyan-Nyan's maguro buns are the best~
I could eat a million of these!
Nom, nom...

More customers?
Looks like this place is as busy as ever...
Huh? Yes, that's fine...
Oh?! Ranka-chan!
Ah! \p-chan!

What's up?
You're not on shift here today... are you?
Or wait, is today your day off?
I see, so that's why you came to Nyan-Nyan.
Then go on, order whatever you like.

It's a reward for always working so hard,
Ranka-chan. Today it's my treat!

It's getting really crowded...
Those customers over there look like
they've been waiting forever...
What's wrong, Ranka-chan?
Oh?

Is it just me...
or is it getting even more packed...?

You looked like you were having fun!
Did it remind you of how you started out?
I see. But you mustn't overdo it, okay?

Okay!
You too, \p-chan! See ya!
See you later!

(Maybe I'd better work hard too,
so she doesn't leave me behind!!)

(Maybe I'll grab a meal at Nyan-Nyan.
It's been a while.)
rows.notes: x2, player (both genders), second visit of frd_rnk_007.

rows.en: Huh, isn't that...
Mind if I share your table?
Of cour~se!
rows.notes: x6, Ranka (also frd_rnk_110, frd_rnk_116, both genders).

rows.en: I ate so much~
Yeah, I'm stuffed.
Did that perk you up?
rows.notes: x2, player to Ranka; genki deta kana.

rows.en: Ehehe...!

Good...
Well then, I'll head home.
rows.notes: Male; sokka after her happy giggle.

rows.en:
(Nyan-Nyan's food puts a smile
on everyone's face.)
Mind if I share your table?

Good...
Well then, I'll head home.
